ci.yml.proof:
needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.suites), 'proof')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: qemu, ovmf, xorriso, gdb (apt)
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -q
          sudo apt-get install -y -q --no-install-recommends qemu-system-x86 ovmf xorriso gdb
          qemu-system-x86_64 --version
          xorriso -version 2>&1 | head -n 1
          ls -l /usr/share/OVMF/

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: .pax-cache
          key: limine-${{ hashFiles('boot/limine.pin') }}

      - name: fetch limine (by digest)
        run: tools/fetch-limine

      - name: expect-serial can say no
        run: tests/expect-serial-selftest

      - name: the proof, BIOS and UEFI
        env:
          PAX_REQUIRE_UEFI: "1"
        run: tests/proof

      - name: the proof's ISO, by digest
        run: |
          sha256sum build/pax-stub.iso > build/pax-stub.iso.sha256
          cat build/pax-stub.iso.sha256

      - name: gdb stops at _start (BIOS)
        run: tests/gdb-attach --firmware bios

      - name: gdb stops at _start (UEFI)
        run: tests/gdb-attach --firmware uefi

      - name: keep the image and the logs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pax-proof-linux
          path: |
            build/pax-stub.iso
            build/pax-stub.iso.sha256
            build/stub/pax-stub.elf
            build/*.log
            build/*.meta
            build/*.out
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: warn
ci.yml.macos-run:
needs: [plan, proof]
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.suites), 'macos-run')
    runs-on: macos-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pax-proof-linux
          path: build

      - name: the very ISO the linux proof booted
        run: shasum -a 256 -c build/pax-stub.iso.sha256

      - name: qemu (Homebrew)
        run: |
          brew install qemu
          qemu-system-x86_64 --version

      - name: the proof on the linux-built ISO, BIOS and UEFI
        env:
          PAX_REQUIRE_UEFI: "1"
        run: tests/proof --image build/pax-stub.iso

  # M-KW (kw05, kw00 §3e): a freestanding wolf kernel, built by the wolf
  # kernel/wolf.pin names on both tiers, linked with the Limine boot
  # path, booted under SeaBIOS and OVMF: serial ends `KWC`, status 33;
  # the trap kernel ends `TRAP 1`, status 3; the machines' refusals as
  # recorded; and the seen-red variants (no --target; KWD) refused in the
  # same run. Every step bare, exit codes read directly.
ci.yml.mkw:
needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.suites), 'mkw')
    env:
      PAX_LEGS: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.legs }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: qemu, ovmf, xorriso, clang, lld (apt)
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -q
          sudo apt-get install -y -q --no-install-recommends qemu-system-x86 ovmf xorriso clang lld binutils
          qemu-system-x86_64 --version
          clang --version
          ld.lld --version

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            .pax-cache/limine-*
            .pax-cache/lupin-*
          key: mkw-${{ hashFiles('boot/limine.pin', 'kernel/wolf.pin') }}

      - name: wolf at the pin (the release archive, by digest)
        run: |
          bin=$(tools/fetch-wolf)
          echo "PAX_WOLF=$bin" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          "$bin" --version

      - name: lupin at the pin (by digest)
        run: |
          bin=$(tools/fetch-lupin)
          echo "PAX_LUPIN=$bin" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          "$bin" --version

      - name: fetch limine (by digest)
        run: tools/fetch-limine

      - name: expect-serial can say no (incl. --tail)
        run: tests/expect-serial-selftest

      - name: M-KW, the plan's legs (all four in the all tier)
        env:
          PAX_REQUIRE_UEFI: "1"
        run: tests/mkw $PAX_LEGS

      - name: keep the kernels and the logs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pax-mkw-linux
          path: |
            build/mkw/
            build/mkw-*.log
            build/mkw-*.meta
            build/mkw-runs.txt

  # px04: the syscall census's own tools. tests/census proves tally.py's

  # px03: paging. kernel/paging builds PAX's own four-level structures

  # px07: the scheduler. Kernel threads on one CPU, switched by the timer
  # (boot/isr.S's trampoline resumes the frame pax_interrupt returns),

  # px06: the kernel heap. kernel/heap is wolf's allocator hook
  # (wolf_alloc, wolf_free; wolf-lang kw12) written in wolf over px02's
  # frames and px03's paging; kernel code allocates through wolf's
  # freestanding runtime (libwolf_rt_none.a, from the pinned archive).
  # tests/mpx2-heap: the archive linked (H1); the empty heap (H2); eight

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

          if-no-files-found: warn

  # px10: the ELF loader and the initramfs (M-PX3's next step). The
  # programs are user/elf/hello.S built here with the runner's gcc and
  # binutils (no libc), packed by tools/mkinitramfs, handed to
  # kmain_loader as a Limine module; hello's output on PAX is compared
  # byte for byte with its output on this runner's own Linux. tests/
  # mpx3-loader: the build (L0), the initramfs (L1), hello against Linux
  # (L2), the segments (L3), six refusals by name (L4), the FPU state per
  # thread (L5), the frames (L6), the halt (L7), and a wolf program
  # linked static against the runner's glibc run until PAX lacks what it
  # asks for (L8, the gap census); both tiers, BIOS and UEFI.
ci.yml.mpx3-loader:
needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.suites), 'mpx3-loader')
    env:
      PAX_LEGS: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.legs }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: qemu, ovmf, xorriso, clang, lld, binutils, gcc, strace (apt)
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -q
          sudo apt-get install -y -q --no-install-recommends qemu-system-x86 ovmf xorriso clang lld binutils gcc libc6-dev strace
          qemu-system-x86_64 --version
          clang --version
          ld.lld --version
          gcc --version | head -n 1
          python3 --version
